title: Solar Panel Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a 6.6kW solar PV system for a single-storey residential property in Penrith, NSW, with a standard terracotta tile roof. System includes sixteen (16) Jinko 415W Tiger Neo N-Type panels, one (1) Sungrow 5kW Hybrid Inverter, and one (1) Sungrow 9.6kWh SBR Battery. Installation involves standard rail mounting for tiles, approximately twenty-five (25) metres of DC cabling and fifteen (15) metres of AC cabling, and all necessary isolator switches and circuit breakers. Labour includes panel and inverter mounting, battery installation, electrical wiring, and system commissioning. This quote will factor in the current STC rebate for the 6.6kW system.
workingDetail: Solar panels (e.g., 415W), Inverter (string or micro), Mounting rails and clamps, DC and AC cabling
